title: Over the fence
summary: Your neighbour's son is fifteen and kicks a ball against your fence every night. Your neighbour asks you to get him a trial. You've seen him play. A season on, he's somewhere.

ends.title: The trial
ends.text: You got your neighbour's lad a trial. He was good, but not good enough, and he says you were the only one who told him why.

ends.title: The fence
ends.text: Your neighbour's lad still kicks a ball against your fence every night. You still haven't said anything about it, either way.

event.title: The fence
event.speaker: neighbour
setup: Every night, ten till half nine: thump, thump, thump. Your neighbour's son against your fence. {neighbour.name} knocks at your door. "He's fifteen. He's mad about it. Could you get him a trial? Just a look."

say: "I know it's a lot to ask. He doesn't know I'm asking. He'd die."

replies.label: "I'll ask the academy to have a look."

say: You watch through the fence on Wednesday. He's quick. His first touch goes everywhere. He never stops.

replies.label: Go round and tell him what you saw. All of it.

trial.text: The academy says yes, as a favour to you. He doesn't sleep for a week. Neither does your neighbour.

told.text: You tell him: quick, never stops, first touch everywhere. He listens with his mouth open. The thumping changes. It's two touches now: control, then hit.

no.text: "No, course." The thumping goes on, every night.

beats.title: A season on

event.title: A season on
event.speaker: neighbour
setup: A season on. It's quiet over the fence tonight. {neighbour.short} is in her front garden. "He's got a trial result," she says. Or: "He's at college now," depending on how you look at it.

outcomes.text: "Not good enough, they said. But he said you were the only one who told him why. He's doing a sports science course. He wants to be a physio." The thumping starts again at ten. Control, then hit.
"He's fine." The thumping starts again at ten past.
At ten the thumping starts. Two touches. Control, then hit. You smile at your own wall.
At ten the thumping starts. You put the telly up.
